mapper.insert: INSERT INTO derive_story_obligation_evidence ( run_id, obligation_key, chapter_no, evidence_kind, event_key, beat_seq, entity_keys, thread_keys, fact, source, confidence ) VALUES ( #{p.runId}, #{p.obligationKey}, #{p.chapterNo}, #{p.evidenceKind}, #{p.eventKey}, #{p.beatSeq}, #{p.entityKeys}::jsonb, #{p.threadKeys}::jsonb, #{p.fact}, #{p.source}, COALESCE(#{p.confidence}, 1.0) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM derive_story_obligation_evidence WHERE run_id = #{runId} AND chapter_no BETWEEN #{fromChapter} AND #{toChapter}
mapper.select: SELECT id, run_id, obligation_key, chapter_no, evidence_kind, event_key, beat_seq, entity_keys, thread_keys, fact, source, confidence, created_time, updated_time, created_user_id, updated_user_id FROM derive_story_obligation_evidence WHERE run_id = #{runId} ORDER BY chapter_no, obligation_key, evidence_kind
